messages:
anya: Quick heads-up 5 I'm going to land a small config-editor addition: `staged_safety_probe` on route objects. Its intended to run quota-routing tweaks in shadow mode and gate rollouts via telemetry. Posting snippet + rollout plan.

anya: ```yaml
route:
  id: "priority-route"
  staged_safety_probe:
    enabled: true
    sample_rate: 0.02
    telemetry_gate: "route.quota_safety_v2"
```

brian: Solid. Two requests: (1) telemetry_gate should produce a counter and a rolling success gauge, (2) need a compact dashboard card (heatmap + sparkline) so ops can eyeball probe health. @devex can you take the card? :eyes:

devex: Yup. Card will show `probe status`, `sample_rate`, `last_sample_time`, and a one-click link to traces. Also a small "download samples" action.

carol: What's the rollout plan and abort criteria?

anya: Draft plan: start shadow/dry-run for 2 hours at 2% sample_rate, then canary to 5% for 30 minutes, escalate to 25% if stable, then 100%. Abort if error-rate delta > 0.5% OR latency P99 increases > 50ms. Gate considered "pass" after sampled success >= 99.8% sustained for 1h.

brian: Also include a replay id header on sampled requests so we can jump from a sample to traces: `X-Config-Probe-ID`. Correlate with trace ids.

anya: Will add header and metrics: `route.probe.sampled_count`, `route.probe.failures`, `route.probe.p99_delta_ms`.

ops-bot: ci:dry-run job queued by anya - id `dryrun-1759456789`

anya: Local smoke command: `./cli config apply --route priority-route --dry-run --probe`

ops-bot: DRY-RUN OUTPUT:
```
DRY-RUN: sampled 120 requests in last 10m, failures 0 (0.0%), p99 +12ms
Telemetry gate: route.quota_safety_v2: not-passed (0.0 -> needs >=99.8%)
```

brian: Can probes also snapshot a tiny sanitized payload to S3 with pre-signed urls so we can replay without digging through logs?

devex: I'll wire the console card to show a "download samples" button that points to the snapshot bucket with pre-signed URLs. Also adding a "replay in traces" button that pre-fills queries using `X-Config-Probe-ID`.

carol: Ops will watch the dry-run and forward concerns. @anya ping when PR is up.

anya: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4870 5 includes schema, server validation, and the `X-Config-Probe-ID` header. Planning to land in 25m unless objections.

brian: :thumbsup: lgtm. Please add metric docs and an example Grafana panel config.

ops-bot: dryrun-1759456789 finished - summary (2h): sampled 4,720 requests, failures 2 (0.042%), avg p99 delta +9ms. No abort triggers. Telemetry gate not-yet-passed (requires sustained 99.8% success).

anya: Thanks 5 I'll watch the dashboard and kick off canary during a quiet hour.

devex: I've mocked the card in staging and dropped the link in #eng-platform. Card shows probe health, last 1h success rate, and download + replay actions.

carol: Thanks team. Short, pragmatic, and traceable. :rocket:
